subject: How to get Exact Image information with file extension and storing it in variable  for Processing

messages.subject: How to get Exact Image information with file extension and storing it in variable  for Processing
parts:
Hi Team,

I have wrote code for uploading Image from UI, displaying it back in main panel. But also I need to do some sort of Image processing (like Resize, extraction of Gray scale image details and converting 28*28 image matrix) and comparing these results back with model and display results back on Main panel. But my problem is , while I passing Image details for processing,i am failing to pass exact image information(path with file extension).
 Here is my code details.
#########################################################
library(shiny)
require(EBImage)

#source("image_processing.R")

server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$files <- renderTable(input$files)
  
  files <- reactive({
    files <- input$files
    files$datapath <- gsub("\\\\", "/", files$datapath)
    print(files)
  })
  

 output$images <- renderUI({
    if(is.null(input$files)) return(NULL)
    image_output_list <- 
      lapply(1:nrow(files()),
             function(i)
             {
               imagename = paste0("image", i)
               imageOutput(imagename)
              
             })
    print(image_output_list)
    do.call(tagList, image_output_list)
  })
  
  observe({
    if(is.null(input$files)) return(NULL)
    for (i in 1:nrow(files()))
    {
      #print(i)
      local({
        my_i <- i
        imagename = paste0("image", my_i)
        #print(imagename)
        output[[imagename]] <- 
          renderImage({
            list(src = files()$datapath[my_i],
                 alt = "Image failed to render")
          }, deleteFile = FALSE)
      })
    }
  })
#image processing step

output$view <- renderTable({
  img <- readImage(files())
  
      img_resized <- resize(img , w=28, h = 28)
      graying <- channel(img_resized, "gray")
      img_matrix <- graying@.Data
      img_vector <- as.vector(t(img_matrix))
      test<- data.matrix(img_vector)
      test_array <- test
      dim(test_array) <- c(28, 28, 1, ncol(test)) 
      
      #Accuracy on test data 
      
      pred_test <- predict(model,test_array)
      pred_test_label <- max.col(t(pred_test))-1
      return(pred_test_label)
    }
  
   )
  
})

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Uploading Files"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      fileInput(inputId = 'files', 
                label = 'Select an Image',
                multiple = TRUE,
                accept=c('image/png', 'image/jpeg'))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput('files'),
      tableOutput('view'),
      uiOutput('images')
    )
  )
))

shinyApp(ui=ui,server=server)
